The color of an eggplant is purple.

**Beginning:** Ben lives on an isolated farm where he unexpectedly discovers the ability to communicate with the animals. As he learns about their lives and struggles, he transitions from a passive resident to their champion.

**Climax:** An impending storm threatens to destroy the farm. Ben orchestrates a daring plan to protect his new animal friends, putting his newfound abilities and leadership to the ultimate test.

**Resolution:** The plan succeeds, leading to the salvation of the farm. Ben finds a new sense of purpose in his role as the protector and voice for the animals.
